incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service= inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1 · condition=5xx_rate > 5% (1m) · value=7.8% · route=/v1/generate · pager=P#12345 · triggered=2026-03-14T10:14:38Z :rotating_light:

maria_oncall: acked — I'm on it. Pulling up dashboards and logs now.

maria_oncall: quick check: p95 latency = 2.3s, error mix is 502/504 from runtime pool, upstream errors, no obvious deploy in last 30m.

jamie_runtime: I'll join. Do we have any autoscaler activity or OOMs? Could be KV cache thrash on long-context requests.

carla_infra: No control-plane deploys. Autoscaler shows runtime nodes in eu-west1 at 92–96% CPU for the last 6m. No obvious node restarts from k8s events.

maria_oncall: Plan: 1) momentarily shift traffic off canary/pinned pools, 2) route latency-sensitive customers to fallback small-model variants, 3) scale runtime pool + restart a few pods if needed.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident P#12345 acknowledged by maria_oncall at 2026-03-14T10:15:02Z. Escalation paused.

maria_oncall: Capturing a failing request for repro:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"long context...","max_tokens":128}'\n
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json

{"error":"upstream runtime error: rpc failed: context deadline exceeded"}
```

jamie_runtime: seeing same in runtime logs — repeated grpc timeouts talking to model-hosts. Example from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-14T10:14:20Z runtime-eu-3 model_client.go:214 ERROR rpc call failed: deadline exceeded, retries=3
2026-03-14T10:14:21Z runtime-eu-2 cache.go:87 WARN kv cache miss rate spiked to 43%
```

carla_infra: I'm scaling runtime pool in eu-west1 now: `rdctl scale runtime-eu-west1 --replicas 8` and bumping node autoscaler target. Kicking a rolling restart on 2 oldest pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-eu-west1 -n prod`

maria_oncall: Changing routing policy to prefer dedicated/reserved pool for critical routes while we recover:
```
rdctl route set /v1/generate --region eu-west1 --policy "prefer:dedicated,fallthrough:small-model" --force
```

maria_oncall: Noting in thread: shifting ~60% of traffic off the problematic runtime pool. Error rate starting to fall: 5xx -> 3.1% (1m).

sophie_support: Support triage: pulling list of customers with >5% errors in past 10m. Early hits: acme-inc (prod), betaapp (eu customers), dataspark (internal). Drafting a brief status update to those customers and to the status page.

jamie_runtime: After scaling and routing change, I'm watching tail of model-host logs — I still see intermittent deadline errors but far fewer. Running a mem/heap profile capture on the affected runtime nodes (`/usr/local/bin/collect-profiles --duration 30s`).

maria_oncall: Error rate now 1.6% (1m) and p95 latency back under 800ms. Good sign. Keeping page open until 15m stable.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident P#12345 resolved by maria_oncall at 2026-03-14T10:23:45Z · duration=9m7s.

maria_oncall: Summary / actions:
- Mitigation: shifted traffic to dedicated pool + scaled runtime nodes + rolling restart of oldest pods. Restored customer impact to minimal within ~6m.
- Hypothesis: KV cache miss storm + model-host RPC latency under memory pressure led to cascading grpc timeouts.
- Follow-ups (created INF-2026-0314):
  * jamie_runtime: analyze heap/profile captures, add memory/fragmentation alerting.
  * carla_infra: tune autoscaler and add warm-up for model-hosts during sudden spikes.
  * product/infra: add circuit breaker at inference-gateway for sustained upstream timeouts (config knob).
  * support: send post-incident customer notifications for the three affected customers.

sophie_support: I'll send the CS notes and status page update now, add links to the incident ticket.

jamie_runtime: filing a runbook PR for quick rollback/reroute steps and an extra check for KV miss rate threshold.

maria_oncall: Closing notes: keeping the channel for follow-ups. Great response — thanks everyone. :heart:

incident-bot: Note: created incident ticket INF-2026-0314 and scheduled postmortem meeting for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.
